sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('26de1ce9-06a9-486f-b27d-2ac635f018d1', '1dc9de56-e259-4546-a1db-23119a8a088e', '17f8f038-c204-4dab-80d7-6f7ac41ddbec') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
